reason: The measurement is right; the inference and the actions are not. I reran r27_comp.py on the exp85a CSV and got the same result: 3,317/122,328 nodes (2.71%) in non-division components of size 6-7, and the same per-clip split. (1) VALUE, the anchor does not transfer. Probes 6/9 ran on exp06, the public 0.941 pipeline + exp03B, with no TTA stack, K, readmit or motion relink. The +0.0025 'gross bonus of min len 8' is measured on the K dummy, not on exp06 on the test embryo. So the 'implied edge loss 0.0013 per 1%' divides a K-dummy numerator into an exp06-public read. The len-8 read is -0.001, one rounding unit. The lab itself labelled -0.001 'noise' (probes 3, 8, 9), so the implied loss has an error bar as large as itself. Probe 6 (len 4, MORE nodes, -0.002) fits the bonus being real in the adding direction, so 'public reads did not collect the bonus' rests on one noise-level read. rho transfer also fails. Size-6/7 components that survive the ILP, readmit and relink are a different population from the short fragments that DIS prunes inside the ILP, before readmit and relink. The finding admits the lab is mixed on rho, so 'net ~0 (-0.0003..+0.0006)' just means 'unknown'. That is already the recorded status: R26 fix 'edge churn of unknown sign ... public unread', and finals card v4 l.58 'DIS 2.25: ~0'. The 'dense clips ratio ~1.00' premise is also loose: dummy_lab_exp89q gives -0.413 on 44b6_0b24. (2) FEASIBILITY / RULES. Actions (3) and (4) are redundant: MORNING TABLE v1.1 already drops DIS unless '+', DIS 1.75 is closed, and MIN_TRACK_LEN is closed. Action (1) is a wording change resting on the non-transferable anchor above. Action (2) is redundant or ill-formed. The pre-registered tie order (CONTEXT l.3181/l.3419: attributable UP > non-CI > fewer levers > earlier submit) already ranks exp89p over exp89q on an equal display. 'exp87a over exp89r' is not a twin pair: it also differs by SEC, and the non-DIS twin of exp89r is exp89l. Inserting 'non-DIS first' above 'attributable UP' would be a post-hoc change to the pre-registered tie order, based on evidence of the kind R26 already rejected ('hard-coding tie-drops-DIS from non-transferable evidence'). Nothing in the night or morning plan changes.
fix: No build and no rule change. At most, add a card footnote to the existing DIS line: 'gross formula bonus ~+0.0007; net sign unknown (edge churn; old exp06 min-len probes 6/9 at -0.002/-0.001 are noise-level and off-base, not evidence either way); public: <DIS_READ>'. Keep the pre-registered tie order as written (attributable UP > non-CI > fewer levers > earlier submit), which already puts exp89p before exp89q and exp87a before exp89r at equal display without an attributable UP. Keep DIS attribution per the R26/MORNING TABLE v1.1 rules (branch B: exp89q vs exp89p; branch A: double difference with a +-0.002 guard).
realistic_gain: 0 on score (public or private). At most a one-line clarity change in the card wording; the tie-order clause adds nothing the existing order does not already do, and its exp87a/exp89r pairing is wrong.
